cohort_title: Evaluating Liquid Biopsies for Methylomic Profiling of Prostate Cancer
cohort_publication: Brikun I et al. 2018, PMID 32000564, University College Dublin
design: Within-patient four-specimen comparison: FFPE benign + FFPE tumor + plasma cfDNA + urine sediment
extraction_protocol: FFPE tissue: QIAamp DNA FFPE tissue kit. Plasma cfDNA: QIAamp Circulating Nucleic Acid (Qiagen) from 3 mL plasma. Urine sediment: AllPrep DNA/RNA/mRNA Universal kit (Qiagen). All samples bisulfite-modified using Zymo EZ DNA methylation kit.
data_access: Public — no dbGaP application required. Series matrix: ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE119nnn/GSE119260/matrix/GSE119260_series_matrix.txt.gz
provenance_warning_advanced_disease: All 4 patients have advanced metastatic disease (bone metastases, Gleason 4+4 to 5+5, PSA range 10.9 to 1400 ng/mL). This cohort is NOT pre-diagnostic and does NOT represent early-stage detection. VAL-065 results on this cohort cannot be extrapolated to early-detection populations.
